title: Islamic mortgage financing: determination of an optimal nisbah of profit-sharing scheme under musharakah mutanaqisah contract
core_idea: Determine an optimal constant nisbah (profit-sharing ratio) for Islamic home financing under a musharakah mutanaqisah contract by modeling the customer's income dynamics with geometric Brownian motion, formulating an objective function that captures fairness between the Islamic bank and customer based on simulated rental and ownership installment payments, and selecting the nisbah that maximizes the objective.
tldr: Find the fair, optimal profit-sharing nisbah in a musharakah mutanaqisah Islamic mortgage by modeling income as a geometric Brownian motion and maximizing a fairness objective using simulated payment data.
